explanation: h(n) is the least L such that every interval (m, m+L) with m ≥ 1 contains distinct a_i divisible by the i-th prime for each i ≤ π(n) (HasPrimeMultiples, 0-indexed primes). Such an L exists, so sInf is the minimum; this matches erdosproblems.com/860. Erdős–Pomerance proved h(n) ≪ n^{3/2}/(log n)^{1/2}. The statement matches. Faithful.
